settings.title: Terms and conditions
settings.body:
Orders are confirmed by the restaurant after you place them. Prices, availability and delivery areas can change by branch.

Payment is cash on delivery or at the counter when you collect.

For questions about an order, contact the branch you ordered from.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
We use your name, email, phone number and delivery address to prepare, deliver and support your orders.

We only use your location when you tap 'Use current location', to find the nearest delivery area. It is not stored unless you save a delivery pin to an address.
